_comment: Curated wildlife-colony overrides for well-known seabird stacks. Strictly island-level presence only (ETHICS §5). No counts, no precise locations. Each entry's `species` list is sourced from public-domain references (Wikipedia, JNCC SPA citations, NPWS SPA citations, RSPB reserve pages) and reflects qualifying species at the named SPA / IBA. Island IDs were resolved against the live data/islands.json to use canonical identifiers.

Sula Sgeir (JNCC SPA UK9001071) — only 'Sula Skerry' (different etymology) present in islands.json; needs disambiguation.
